title: Practice 1: Adverbs of place, time and manner

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What does в- add in вско́ре (“soon”)?
options: giving or acquiring a status or state
quantity
movement into something
the manner of an action, given by the base word
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists вско́ре under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 4 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).

exercises.q: What does в- add in вкра́тце (“summarily, in a nutshell, briefly”)?
options: thoroughness, fullness of an action
movement into something
giving or acquiring a status or state
the manner of an action, given by the base word
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists вкра́тце under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 4 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).

exercises.q: What does в- add in вполне́ (“quite, fully, entirely”)?
options: the manner of an action, given by the base word
giving or acquiring a status or state
quantity
movement into something
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists вполне́ under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 4 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).

exercises.q: What does в- add in вниз (“downwards”)?
options: added to verbs, forms verbs with the approximate meaning 'in' or 'into'
added to nouns, forms adverbs with the approximate meaning 'in the direction or location of [the noun]'
alternative form of в- (used before certain consonant clusters)
added to adjectives, forms adverbs with the approximate meaning 'in the manner of [the adjective]'
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists вниз under this meaning of в-. Source: Wiktionary, «в-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-#Russian).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вско́ре — soon; вкра́тце — summarily, in a nutshell, briefly; вполне́ — quite, fully, entirely; вниз — downwards.

exercises.q: What does на- add in наза́д (“back, backward, backwards”)?
options: (added to nouns, forms adverbs with the meaning in the direction of the noun)
onto, upon
to repletion, to satiation, to the full, enough, too much
(added to nouns or adverbs, forms adverbs with the approximate meaning 'for' the noun or adverb, or in the state of the noun or adverb)
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists наза́д under this meaning of на-. Source: Wiktionary, «на-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/на-#Russian).

exercises.q: What does на- add in навсегда́ (“forever”)?
options: (added to nouns or adverbs, forms adverbs with the approximate meaning 'for' the noun or adverb, or in the state of the noun or adverb)
(added to nouns, forms adverbs with the meaning in the direction of the noun)
to repletion, to satiation, to the full, enough, too much
a quantity of, a lot of
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists навсегда́ under this meaning of на-. Source: Wiktionary, «на-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/на-#Russian).

exercises.q: What does с- add in сбо́ку (“askance (sideways, obliquely)”)?
options: removing, getting rid of
the limit, the result of the action itself
place or manner of an action
joint or mutual action, joining
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists сбо́ку under this meaning of с-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «с-», meaning 9 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-).

exercises.q: What does с- add in све́рху (“from above, on top”)?
options: removing, getting rid of
place or manner of an action
the limit, the result of the action itself
movement from above downwards
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists све́рху under this meaning of с-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «с-», meaning 9 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: наза́д — back, backward, backwards; навсегда́ — forever; сбо́ку — askance (sideways, obliquely); све́рху — from above, on top.

exercises.q: What does с- add in сле́ва (“on the left; from the left”)?
options: movement from above downwards
place or manner of an action
movement from different sides to one point

exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists сле́ва under this meaning of с-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «с-», meaning 9 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-).
